intent:
Fix a small daemon-log noise bug: the conversation committer fails with a git pathspec error in every project that has no .the-framework/conversations directory yet.

Where: packages/the-framework/src/conversation-commit.ts (the daemon-side job that commits recorded conversation files). When the project has no .the-framework/conversations directory, its git add fails with "pathspec ... did not match any files" and the failure lands in the daemon log on every cycle. This is benign noise: nothing to commit is a normal state, not an error.

The fix: guard the commit step so the no-directory (and empty-directory) case is silently skipped, while real git failures still get logged. Add or extend a unit test covering the missing-directory case. Run the package test suite (cd packages/the-framework && pnpm test) and make it pass. Add a changeset file in .changeset/ marking '@gemstack/the-framework' as a patch. Open a draft pull request explaining the fix.
